claim.quote: These tests reveal that the Higgs boson discovered ten years ago is remarkably consistent with the predictions of the theory and provide stringent constraints on many models of new phenomena beyond the Standard Model.

date.note: arXiv submission date; published as Nature 607 (2022) 52.

name: A detailed map of Higgs boson interactions, ten years after the discovery

significance.note: A combination paper reporting many measurements; no single significance is quoted in the abstract.

summary.plain: Ten years after the discovery, ATLAS combined an unprecedented number of Higgs boson production and decay measurements from its larger dataset to test how the particle interacts with others. The collaboration reports that the Higgs boson is remarkably consistent with the predictions of the theory.
summary.technical: Combination of ATLAS measurements of Higgs boson production and decay rates using the full Run 2 dataset (139 fb⁻¹ at 13 TeV) to study the Higgs boson's interactions with gluons, photons, W and Z bosons, b and t quarks and tau leptons, with indications of interactions with muons; published in Nature 607, 52–59 (2022).

title: A detailed map of Higgs boson interactions by the ATLAS experiment ten years after the discovery
why_it_matters: The abstract says these tests reveal that the Higgs boson is remarkably consistent with the predictions of the theory and provide stringent constraints on many models of new phenomena beyond the Standard Model.
